taskDescription: Write real unit tests for the Claude Code hook scripts pre-tool-use-hook.sh and post-tool-use-hook.sh. Do NOT just read the code and assert strings exist — actually execute the scripts and assert their behavior. Tests must: (1) set up a real brain.json in a temp dir, (2) pipe real JSON to the scripts via stdin, (3) capture and assert stdout/stderr and file state changes. Cover: pre-hook injects brain state into prompt, pre-hook sets *-running phase flag, pre-hook exits cleanly when no brain.json exists, pre-hook emits valid JSON on stdout, post-hook merges brain-patch.json into brain.json, post-hook sets *-complete and clears *-running, post-hook deletes brain-patch.json after merge, post-hook exits cleanly when no brain.json exists. Tests should live in tests/test_hooks.py and use subprocess to actually invoke the shell scripts. Follow the same pytest style as tests/test_docs_template_compliance.py.
